about:
J & C Wood Products operates from Plaucheville, Louisiana, a town of roughly 288 residents. The company was founded in 2001 by Jody and Candace Chenevert, who brought over 25 years of hardwood industry experience to the venture. Starting from humble beginnings, the couple built a business focused on reclaimed and specialty wood products.

The company mills solid wood flooring from reclaimed antique heart pine, white oak, hickory/pecan, and hemlock, as well as producing beams, table tops, counter tops, stair treads, mantles, doors, cabinets, charcuterie boards, and pre-finished engineered flooring. A key process is thermally modified kiln drying, where wood is heated above 180°C in an oxygen-free environment for up to five days to enhance durability without chemicals. Reclaimed beams are sourced from antique structures across the United States and milled to custom dimensions. The operation includes a showroom at its new mill facility.

J & C serves both commercial and residential markets, supplying flooring and beams to homeowners, builders, and designers. Its products have been featured in Design & Build Magazine of Southwest Louisiana, and customer testimonials reference projects in Arkansas, Louisiana, and New Orleans. The company also provides installation services through its own crews.

The Cheneverts emphasize old-world craftsmanship, positioning their La Olden brand as ultra-premium unfinished flooring made in the traditions of traditional artisans. The thermally modified wood line is promoted as a sustainable, chemical-free option for outdoor applications with a lifespan of 25 to 50 years.
